name: add_node_to_workspace
author: hprebar
title: Add node to Dynamo workspace
description: Places a new node instance onto the active Dynamo workspace canvas at specified coordinates (X, Y), optionally setting its display name or initial value. Supports CodeBlock, standard Core nodes, and Revit nodes.
notes: Executes DynamoModel.CreateNodeCommand within the active workspace.

nodeType.description: Node creation identifier or type name (e.g. 'DSCoreNodes.Point', 'CodeBlock', 'CoreNodeModels.Watch', 'DSCore.Color.ByARGB')

x.description: Horizontal position X on the workspace canvas in pixels

y.description: Vertical position Y on the workspace canvas in pixels

name.description: Optional custom display title for the created node

initialValue.description: Optional initial value or code expression (used when creating a CodeBlock, String, or Number node)
